Source I It wasn’t long after that a black smoke come through. A strange black smoke, it was shiny and oily. A few hours later we all got crook, every one of us. They were too weak to survive all the sickness.
YAMI LESTER, a Yankunytjatjara elder from South Australia
T RUFF and D HAWKINS ‘315 nuclear bombs and ongoing suffering: the shameful history of nuclear testing in Australia and the Pacific’ The Conversation, 2020
